answer: The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, capped per identity per epoch, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. The marble is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the delta. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. By the inlet of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up.
